summary: National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corporation filed an 8-K on October 16, 2026, reporting an Item 8.01 update on routine debt programs rather than a special situation. The registrant filed a prospectus supplement for unlimited Member Capital Securities, Series 2026 sold to voting members, and entered an MTN agency agreement with twelve dealers (RBC, BMO, JPMorgan, Truist, US Bancorp among them) continuing its unlimited Medium-Term Notes, Series D program. A separate InterNotes agency agreement with InspereX, Citigroup, RBC and Wells Fargo continues that retail note program. No price, premium, board recommendation or regulatory clock is stated; watch only for issuance pace and member take-up.
